# Fonts for synthetic photos

The synthetic data generator (`Synthetic/`) draws receipts and dashboards with these fonts. They are embedded in the reader and
licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licence texts next to them, also published with the reader).

| File | Font | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSEG7Classic-Regular.ttf` | DSEG7 Classic 0.46 (seven-segment displays) | https://github.com/keshikan/DSEG |
| `LiberationMono-Regular.ttf` | Liberation Mono 2.1.5 (receipt printers) | https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts |
| `LiberationSans-Bold.ttf` | Liberation Sans Bold 2.1.5 (TFT dashboards) | https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts |
